```{r hrd_internal_setup}
#| echo: false

tumor_site <- pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$site
cna_conf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$somatic_cna
```

```{r hrd_internal}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

genome_doubled <- isTRUE(as.logical(cna_conf$genome_doubled))
wgd_fraction <- cna_conf$wgd_fraction

cat(
  "The genomic scar score estimated by PCGR (the HRD score) is the **sum of three genomic scar measures**, all derived from the ",
  "allele-specific copy number segments:\n\n",
  "* **HRD-LOH** - the number of loss-of-heterozygosity (LOH) regions longer than 15 Mb that do not span a whole chromosome ",
  "([Abkevich et al. 2012](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23047548/))\n",
  "* **LST (large-scale state transitions)** - the number of chromosomal breakpoints between adjacent regions of at least 10 Mb ",
  "([Popova et al. 2012](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22933060/))\n",
  "* **TAI (telomeric allelic imbalance)** - the number of regions with allelic imbalance that extend to the telomere without crossing the centromere ",
  "([Birkbak et al. 2012](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22576213/))\n\n",
  "The implementation follows the [**scarHRD**](https://github.com/sztup/scarHRD) algorithm ",
  "([Sztupinszki et al. 2018](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29978035/)), and is computed on autosomes only.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

hrd_conf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$somatic_cna

## component scores in a toned-down style, so that the focus is on the sum
component_theme <- bslib::value_box_theme(bg = "#ced4da", fg = "#212529")

bslib::layout_columns(
  col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
  height = "110px",
  bslib::value_box(
    title = "HRD-LOH",
    value = hrd_conf$hrd_loh,
    #"LOH regions > 15 Mb",
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = component_theme
  ),
  bslib::value_box(
    title = "LST",
    value = hrd_conf$hrd_lst,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = component_theme
  ),
  bslib::value_box(
    title = "TAI",
    value = hrd_conf$hrd_tai,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = component_theme
  ),
  bslib::value_box(
    title = "HRD score (sum)",
    value = hrd_conf$hrd_sum,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = "dark"
  )
)

cat("\n\n")

cat("**How to read the score:** the score counts genomic scars, so a higher score means more scarring and a higher likelihood of HRD ",
    "(in ovarian cancer, also of benefit from PARP inhibitors). There is no fixed upper limit - scores typically range from 0 to about 100 ",
    "in TCGA tumors, with near-diploid, stable genomes scoring close to 0. A score of 42 or above is the established cutoff for HRD-positive ",
    "tumors in ovarian cancer only (see the note below); no cutoff has been validated in other cancer types.\n\n", sep = "")

lenz2023 <- "[Lenz et al. 2023](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37589839/)"
rempel2022 <- "[Rempel et al. 2022](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35681079/)"
telli2016 <- "[Telli et al. 2016](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26957554/)"
marquard2015 <- "[Marquard et al. 2015](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26015868/)"
popova2012 <- "[Popova et al. 2012](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22933060/)"
bielski2018 <- "[Bielski et al. 2018](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30013179/)"

if (tumor_site == "Ovary/Fallopian Tube") {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\n## Note - interpretation (ovarian cancer)\n\n",
      "In ovarian cancer, a score of 42 or above is the threshold used by the Myriad myChoice CDx assay, an FDA-approved companion diagnostic, ",
      "to define HRD-positive tumors (a lower threshold of 33 has also been explored) (", lenz2023, "). ",
      "The three component scores were originally developed on SNP-array data (", marquard2015, "). In TCGA ovarian tumors, scores derived ",
      "from whole-exome sequencing correlated strongly with array-derived scores (R = 0.87), but were slightly higher (by 4%) (", rempel2022, "), ",
      "and thresholds have not been formally established for sequencing-derived scores. ",
      "**The score shown here is intended for research use only and is not a validated diagnostic measure.**",
      "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
} else if (tumor_site == "Breast") {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\n## Note - interpretation (breast cancer)\n\n",
      "In triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), homologous recombination deficiency (defined as a score of 42 or above, or a BRCA1/2 mutation) ",
      "was associated with response to platinum-based neoadjuvant therapy (", telli2016, "), and thresholds of both 42 and 33 were significant ",
      "predictors of response (", lenz2023, "). In ER-positive breast cancer, the scores of BRCA1/2-deficient tumors were lower than in ovarian cancer, ",
      "and the ovarian cancer thresholds do not appear appropriate (", lenz2023, "). The breast cancer subtype is not taken into account here. ",
      "**The score shown here is intended for research use only and is not a validated diagnostic measure.**",
      "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n## Caution - interpretation (", tumor_site, ")\n\n",
      "Genomic scar scores have not been validated as markers of HRD outside ovarian cancer and triple-negative breast cancer. Subsets of high-scoring tumors ",
      "exist in most cancer types, including those types for which platinum-based chemotherapy is not standard therapy (", marquard2015, "). ",
      "The score separates tumors with biallelic BRCA1/2 inactivation well (AUC = 0.89), but tumors with monoallelic BRCA1/2 alterations poorly ",
      "(AUC = 0.53), and the authors argue for interpreting it together with the mutational status of HRR genes (", rempel2022, "). ",
      "The scar measures are also influenced by ploidy: LST was originally defined with ploidy-specific cutoffs (", popova2012, "), whereas the ",
      "HRD score is an unweighted sum of the three measures (", telli2016, "). A high score should therefore not, on its own, be interpreted as ",
      "evidence of HRD or of sensitivity to PARP inhibitors. **The score shown here is intended for research use only.**",
      "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}

if (genome_doubled) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n## Caution - genome doubling\n\n",
      "This tumor is classified as having undergone whole-genome doubling (", round(100 * wgd_fraction), "% of the autosomal genome has a major ",
      "allele copy number of two or more; criterion of ", bielski2018, "). Genome doubling is common in advanced cancers (nearly 30%) and ",
      "associated with TP53 mutation (", bielski2018, "), and ploidy influences the scar measures (", popova2012, "). The interpretability of ",
      "the HRD score is therefore limited in this tumor.",
      "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}

if (isTRUE(as.logical(pcg_report$settings$conf$assay_properties$vcf_tumor_only))) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n## Caution - tumor-only analysis\n\n",
      "This sample was analyzed in tumor-only mode. The HRD score is derived from the copy number segments only, and is reliable only if ",
      "these were called with a matched control sample. Without a matched control, germline runs of homozygosity (common in some populations, ",
      "and with parental relatedness) cannot be distinguished from somatic loss-of-heterozygosity, and may inflate HRD-LOH (and TAI).",
      "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}

```
